# A template variable can be added to after it is declared. Definitions
# parsed by those later calls are reported alongside the ones from the
# declaration.

check-templates -definitions
cmpenv stdout want.txt
! stderr .

-- want.txt --
$WORK/about.gohtml:1:1+21	"farewell"	$WORK/about.gohtml:1:25+7	$WORK/about.gohtml:1:10+10
-- go.mod --
module example.com/app

go 1.25.0
-- main.go --
package main

import (
	"embed"
	"fmt"
	"html/template"
	"io"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var source embed.FS

type Page struct {
	Title string
}

var ts = template.Must(template.New("app").ParseFS(source, "index.gohtml"))

func setup() {
	template.Must(ts.ParseFS(source, "about.gohtml"))
}

func render() {
	_ = ts.ExecuteTemplate(io.Discard, "farewell", Page{Title: "Home"})
}

var _ = fmt.Sprint

-- index.gohtml --
<h1>{{.Title}}</h1>
-- about.gohtml --
{{define "farewell"}}Bye{{end}}
